thread:
emily: FYI hitting flaky failures in eval-runner for structured tool_call tests when bringing up quantized-v2q. sometimes the runner flags schema mismatch even though human-inspection shows valid JSON. :confused:

emily: example output from the model:```json
{
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "lookup",
    "arguments": "{\"query\": [\"alpha\", \"beta\"]}"
  }
}
```

emily: note the arguments field is a string containing JSON (escaped quotes) and the inner array order is preserved but sometimes the runner sees it as raw list vs escaped-string depending on tokenizer split. failing schema expects arguments: object not string.

raj: can you paste the failing validator log? is it our JSONSchema lib or the runner pre-normalization? :eyes:

emily: logger snippet:```
ValidatorError: /tool_call/arguments: expected object, got string
 at validate (/opt/eval-runner/node_modules/ajv/index.js:...)
```

mike: i think the issue is the model sometimes emits a function-call as a stringified JSON (intentional) and sometimes as structured object. our schema is strict. we need runner canonicalization step: if arguments is string and looks like JSON, parse it before validating. also watch for embedded newlines and single quotes.

lisa: agreed. but be careful: blind parse could change semantics for tools that expect raw strings. maybe add a config flag per eval that allows "auto_destringify_arguments": true. default false.

sam: we should also add two metrics: schema_pass_rate (after canonicalization) and strict_structure_match (before canonicalization). that'll help us see whether parsing is masking model regressions.

eval-runner: running quick repro on CI image -> reproduces on 3/120 structured-toolcall evals. attaching minimal repro in the PR. :bug:

ci-bot: build 4821 | tests/evals/structured-toolcall failed (3 failed) — see https://ci.redwood-inference.com/4821/logs/structured-toolcall for details :x:

raj: if we add config flag, we also need evaluator-level tests that cover: 1) stringified-json -> parse => pass, 2) string-but-not-json -> fail, 3) already-object -> pass.

mike: small edgecase: nested arrays sometimes come back with trailing commas from edge model variants (`,]`) — ajv will choke. we can add a tolerant-json parse that strips trailing commas and common single-quote to double-quote fixes, but log every correction under a new metric (corrections_applied).

emily: i've opened PR #2134 with a prototype: runner will attempt safeParse(arguments) if config.auto_destringify_arguments is true, emit corrections_applied++ on any mutation, and report both metrics. tests + changelog included.

lisa: will review today. also add a note to onboarding checklist: for new quantized models, run structured-toolcall smoke with both strict and tolerant modes and compare diff of function args.

sam: can we gate Dedicated bring-up on strict_structure_match >= 0.98 for the core toolcall suite? otherwise we risk regressions in downstream tooling.

emily: yes will add gating threshold to the PR description and CI job. thanks all. :thumbsup:
